content: I'll start by reading the test image to analyze the symptoms.

- Multiple brown necrotic lesions of varying sizes — smaller circular spots scattered throughout, plus larger irregular blotches at leaf margins

- No obvious white powdery coating, no concentric ring (target) pattern

- Prominent **yellow chlorotic halos** surrounding brown lesions
- Both small scattered spots AND coalescing larger blotches at leaf margins

The Septoria reference doesn't match well. The test image better matches **Early Blight** (Alternaria solani):
- Brown necrotic lesions with yellow halos are hallmark of Early Blight
- Lesions of varied sizes are consistent (older lesions enlarge and coalesce)
- Yellow chlorosis surrounding lesions is very typical
- Pattern on tomato leaf with multiple infection sites
